about: Every poll in Wikipedia's polling tables for the 2019-04-09 election, from the day after the previous election (2015-03-17) to the day before the vote, newest first: 232 polls by 34 pollsters (13 by Shlomo Filber's firms). The outgoing Knesset was dissolved on 2018-12-26 (109 polls since). Same schema as the 28-day files in data/, with the same lists, blocs, agreements and result as data/2019-04.json; parties that merged, split or withdrew during the campaign have their own ids, listed in otherLists (`into` names the final list they merged into). Built by scripts/forecast/backtest/build-data-full.py; memo docs/research/polls-method/round2/D1-data-full.md.
blocNote: The right bloc as Wikipedia's 'R' column and calibration.json count it: Likud, Kulanu, Shas, UTJ, URWP, Yisrael Beiteinu, New Right, Zehut. Gesher is counted with the opposition (centre-left, Orly Levy).
